subject_label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)
object_label: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
comment: Partial: task-book evaluation on qualifying assignments evidences briefing and stop-work practice in the incident setting only; field and facility settings need separate evidence. Check currency.

subject_label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)
object_label: Suppress wildland fire safely with ground tactics and resources
comment: Firefighter-type qualifications evidence the entry CLO; higher positions map to higher levels only through MOD-11 anchors (ADR-0004 §8), never by equivalence.

subject_label: Wildland fire position qualifications under the interagency standard (e.g., firefighter, burn boss, incident commander types)
object_label: Evaluate and certify others' task performance against position standards
comment: Holding a position qualification does not evidence evaluating others; signed evaluator records on completed task books may, through a portfolio review.

subject_label: State certified prescribed burn manager
object_label: Conduct prescribed fire from burn planning through ignition, holding and evaluation
comment: Partial and state-specific: certification content and practical requirements vary by state; accept with a burn plan and an observed burn record.

subject_label: NIMS/ICS training (IS-100, 200, 700, 800; ICS-300/400) and NQS position qualifications
object_label: Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents
comment: Course completion evidences incident-command knowledge statements only, not observed incident communication; use with an exercise or incident observation.

subject_label: HAZWOPER training (40-hour, 24-hour, 8-hour supervisor; 8-hour annual refresher)
object_label: Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites
comment: A training record is an entry gate and evidence of instruction, not of observed safe work on a hazardous site; performance needs an observed drill or task-book entry.

subject_label: HAZWOPER training (40-hour, 24-hour, 8-hour supervisor; 8-hour annual refresher)
object_label: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
comment: Training record only; safety-culture CLOs need observed briefing, stop-work and reporting behaviour.

subject_label: FAA Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107)
object_label: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems
comment: The certificate rests on a knowledge test, not a practical flight evaluation [J; LC-040 unverified]; accept as evidence for the UAS-rules knowledge statements and as a legal gate, not for flight performance.

subject_label: Drinking water treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV / Class A-D, state-specific)
object_label: Operate drinking water treatment processes to meet water quality targets
comment: Grade-dependent: lower grades evidence L1 and higher grades up to L3 through MOD-01 anchors; responsible charge is a sign-off gate, not a level (ADR-0004 §8). State-specific; check currency.

subject_label: Wastewater treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV)
object_label: Operate wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes to permit limits
comment: Grade-dependent as for drinking water; state-specific; check currency.

subject_label: Certified Wildlife Biologist (CWB) / Associate Wildlife Biologist (AWB)
object_label: Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys
comment: Partial: the certification reviews education and experience rather than observing field performance [J]; accept with a survey work sample or blind re-measurement.

subject_label: Professional Wetland Scientist (PWS) / Wetland Professional in Training (WPIT)
object_label: Delineate wetlands and other aquatic resources in the field
comment: Partial: experience-based certification; accept with a delineation work sample checked in the field. Object competency pending authoring (FC, MOD-02).

subject_label: GIS Professional (GISP)
object_label: Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data
comment: Partial: portfolio and examination evidence spatial-data practice; tool-specific skills stay in L4 and are not credited here.

subject_label: Registered Environmental Health Specialist / Registered Sanitarian (REHS/RS)
object_label: Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure
comment: Partial: examination-based registration evidences environmental-health knowledge; hazard-investigation performance needs an observed inspection or investigation record.

subject_label: SAF Certified Forester (CF)
object_label: Inventory forest resources to stated precision with field plots and remote sensing
comment: Partial: education-and-experience certification; accept with an inventory work sample or cruise-data record.

subject_label: Certified Ecological Restoration Practitioner (CERP) / CERP-in-Training
object_label: Implement ecological restoration treatments and adapt them to site response
comment: Partial: portfolio-based certification of restoration practice; check that the portfolio includes implementation under non-routine site conditions.

subject_label: Certified Floodplain Manager (CFM)
object_label: Administer local floodplain management regulations and flood insurance programme requirements
comment: Partial: examination-based; accept with a permit or substantial-damage determination work sample.

subject_label: Federal contracting officer's representative certification (FAC-COR)
object_label: Manage client and partner scope for environmental work
comment: Partial and public-side only: training-based certification evidences the technical-representative enactment's rules, not scope drafting or negotiation performance.

subject_label: State environmental inspector credential (programme-issued delegation to inspect)
object_label: Conduct regulatory compliance inspections
comment: Where the programme issues the credential after observed inspections, it evidences independent inspection; check the issuing programme's evaluation record.

subject_label: Wilderness First Aid / Wilderness First Responder
object_label: Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings
comment: Courses with a practical skills assessment evidence the entry CLO; check currency (typically two to three years).

subject_label: Professional Engineer (PE), incl. Environmental and Civil (Water Resources) exams
object_label: Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality
comment: Licensure is a legal sign-off gate for engineering work, not evidence of project-delivery performance (ADR-0003 T-8).
